fuse_modules_conv_bn_relu: fuse a sequence of conv, bn, and relu modules in a pytorch model into a single fused module
fuse_modules_linear_relu: fuse a sequence of linear and relu modules in a pytorch model into a single fused module
fuse_modules_qat: fuse conv, bn, relu or linear, relu module sequences in a pytorch model for quantization-aware training
fuse_modules_inplace: fuse module sequences in-place on a pytorch model without creating a deep copy
fuse_modules_custom_mapping: fuse module sequences using a custom fuser method mapping provided via fuse_custom_config_dict
